title: Where do agents sit?
prompt: Pick the accurate description of an agent.

options.text: The governed workflow wrapper that packages skills, tools, and knowledge together.
options.feedback: Correct. Agents operationalize skills, actions, and MCP into production workflows.

options.text: A connector that indexes a proprietary data source.
options.feedback: No. That is the connector framework, a different build surface.

options.text: An SDK for embedding search into a web application.
options.feedback: No. That is the embedded experience and Client API surface.
